Cr"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"edentials are **never stored in config**: env-var references resolved per operation via `ctx.credent"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"ials` (`SHOPIFY_SHOP_DOMAIN` + `SHOPIFY_ADMIN_API_TOKEN`, fallback `SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN`).
